thread:
ari: Quick flag FYI — saw a cascade when the new default for `route.quota_mode` propagated from console to routing service in staging. Started at ~1712348800 and caused a 4x surge to dedicated pools.
jamie: 😬 did it auto-apply without dry-run?
ari: Yeah, console applied to "service:*" scope. UI showed preview but we didn't have the dry-run checkbox enabled by default. Ops metrics only alerted after burst.
priya: Can you paste the config diff? we need to reproduce.
ari: Here —
```json
{"route.quota_mode":"aggressive","quota.multiplier":4}
```
sylvia: That's ugly. Cascade rules should have an explicit 'approve' step for wide-scope changes.
ben: +1. We discussed scoped rollouts but console still lets global apply without require-approval flag.
ops-bot: prod-alert: routing-pool-utilization > 90% for 30s (staging)
jamie: Proposal: console defaults to "preview-only" for patterns with wildcard scopes and require a two-step confirm for >2x multiplier changes.
priya: Also add a preflight: run simulated cost/latency check against sampled traffic and show expected delta. If delta > threshold, block by UX.
ari: Implementation notes: API currently supports `dry_run=true` param but console doesn't call it for scope=*. We can add a guard in the API: reject applies with scope wildcard unless `force=true` and requester belongs to `ops` group.
sylvia: Ops won't like being gatekeepers for all wide changes. Maybe require a tag `requires-ops-ack` on the console apply modal that opens a slack approval flow instead.
ben: Technical concern: if we make the API reject by default, infra automation (scripts) will break. We need an allowlist for service-accounts with justification metadata.
priya: We can add `apply_metadata: {reason, runbook_link, owner}` — console will surface a small form. Service tokens must include `justification` header.
jamie: Telemetry: capture `pre_change_snapshot` + `post_change_preview` and store diff id. Expose in Rollouts dashboard so on incidents we can see which change caused the spike.
ari: For rollbacks, we should auto-create a revert change that sets previous values and mark it `auto_revert_candidate` in the UI with one-click apply.
sylvia: Can we gate by simulated canary? i.e., apply to 1% cohort with live shadow traffic and compare latency and pool pressure for 15m before gradual ramp.
ben: That requires runtime support. Routing service supports cohort routing but console+API need a rollout plan DSL. Draft:
```yaml
plan:
  - cohort: 1%
    duration: 15m
    checks:
      - metric: pool_util
        threshold: 80
      - metric: p50_latency
        threshold: +10%
  - cohort: 10%
    duration: 30m
``` 
priya: Love that. Also add `auto_abort_on` config to stop rollout and surface reason.
ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-1123 to add allowlist + justification-header.
ari: Next steps: (1) console UX change: default preview-only for wildcard scopes + justification form; (2) API change: require justification header or allowlist; (3) telemetry: pre/post diffs + rollout trace id; (4) runbook: include a checklist and rollback button.
jamie: I'll pickup (1) and (3). priya take (2) and ben design rollout DSL prototype.
priya: ack. I'll add API schema in the morning and include tests.
sylvia: I'll write a short ops-playbook for rapid rollback and add to incident runbooks.
ben: I'll mock the DSL in the demo console and add validations.
ari: Thanks everyone. Please add to PRs and link INF-1123 in descriptions.
jamie: 🎯
ben: :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: ticket INF-1123 updated with assignees: jamie, priya, ben
sylvia: pinging @product for visibility — this affects console defaults.
product-bot: noted. Product queued for next prioritization.
ari: keeping this thread as the single source for rollout plan details — drop updates here.
